Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misunderstood basic phase-change science and selected C) It became a gas instead of D) It became a solid. A freezer causes liquids to freeze into solids; dissolved sugar lowers the freezing point (freezing point depression), not raises it, and juice typically freezes in a household freezer overnight. The agent also prematurely declared the task complete without systematic option analysis or engaging specialists.
